fontTheory.description: The typography system aims to balance professionalism with readability, using a mix of sans-serif and serif fonts for different elements.
fontTheory.readability: The chosen fonts offer good contrast and legibility, ensuring easy reading across various screen sizes.
fontTheory.hierarchy: The hierarchy is established through font sizes, weights, and styles, with headings in sans-serif for a modern touch and body text in serif for a classic feel.
fontTheory.fontPairings: Helvetica Neue and Arial complement each other well, providing a clean and contemporary look, while Georgia and Times New Roman offer a traditional and elegant contrast for body text.
